subject: general
question: If a person has difficulty in seeing distant objects clearly, what condition is he suffering from and how can it be corrected?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Myopia, using concave lens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Myopia, also known as nearsightedness or short-sightedness, is a common vision condition in which you can see objects near to you clearly, but objects farther away appear blurry.
 
• It occurs when the shape of your eye causes light rays to bend (refract) incorrectly, focusing the images in front of the retina instead of directly on the retina.
 
• Myopia, also known as nearsightedness or short-sightedness, is a vision condition characterized by the eye's inability to focus on distant objects clearly.
 
• People with myopia can see objects clearly if they're close to their eyes, but things that are further away—like road signs or a blackboard in a classroom—appear blurred.
 
• This happens because the eyeball is too long from front to back, or the cornea—the clear front cover of the eye—is too curved.
 
• Essentially, the light that enters the eye isn't focused correctly.
 
• With normal vision, the light is focused directly onto the retina at the back of the eye, creating a sharp image.
 
• But in myopia, the light is focused in front of the retina. This incorrect focus results in a blurry appearance for distant objects.
 
• There are various causes of myopia. Genetics plays a crucial role—if parents are myopic, then there are more likely to be myopic as well.
 
• Further, some evidence suggests that focusing on nearby objects for prolonged periods during childhood might contribute to developing myopia.
 
• Myopia typically begins in childhood and might gradually worsen as the person grows, often stabilizing in early adulthood.
 
• Management strategies range from corrective lenses like glasses or contact lenses to surgical procedures aimed at reshaping the cornea.
 
• Regular eye examinations can help detect myopia and other vision disorders early, preventing potential future issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Hypermetropia**

 
 
• In hypermetropia the image is formed behind the retina and a person cannot see nearby objects clearly.
 
• It can be corrected using a convex lens. It helps focus the rays entering the eye on the retina.
